{{Top|leg}}
A '''cargo loadlifter''' was a surface vehicle. Cargo loadlifters were part of the vehicle pool deployed to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[IM-455 modular garrison]]s. They were stored in the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison's]] vehicle bay when not in use.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>
